reasons.correctness: Currency.displayOrder, CurrencyDtoOut.displayOrder, toDto (ModelMapper) and getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos all carry the field; hidden tests 4/4. The changeset seeds only PLN/EUR/USD, so any other currency keeps 0 and would sort before PLN.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset sits in 2026/09 with a DD-MM-YYYY kebab name, the liquibase header, a changeset line and a rollback. It is included last in changelog.xml under a 'September 2026:' comment. No existing changeset edited; constructor-built tests updated.
reasons.design_fit: The change adds one builder/setter line to each existing CurrencyDtoOut mapping (CurrencyController, CurrencyService, the partnership and applied-opportunity services) so client responses stay consistent. It adds no new mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyServiceDisplayOrderUnitTest uses MockitoExtension and a real ModelMapper, and covers toDto and the paged mapping with tuple assertions plus an empty page. It has no case for the default 0 or for mixed ordering.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the currency entities, their TESTED_BY tests and their dependents before any read. The agent then read an existing display-order changeset as the template. It found the manual CurrencyDtoOut builders mostly through grep.
